$comment: Single source of truth for every hero and content image on the site. Paths: `source` is relative to the repo-root Content/ folder, `output` is relative to apps/front-end/public/. `crop` is either "attention" (sharp smart-crop) or a box in source-image fractions {left, top, width, height}. `locked: true` marks an original committed image: the build skips it so it is never re-encoded. Run: node .agents/skills/image_generation/build_images.cjs `reference` + `prompt` feed generate_images.cjs (Gemini).
